key_idea: Parse the octal number, split it into the played mask and the X mask, and test the 8 winning line masks for each player.
sketch: Read each token with base 8, played = bits 0-8, X = played & bits 9-17, O = played & ~bits 9-17. Check the 8 line masks against X and O; a legal state has at most one winner. If nobody wins and all 9 cells are played it is Cat's, otherwise In progress. O(1) per state. Pitfalls: the leading 0 octal convention (do not read as decimal), masking the X bits by the played bits, and checking wins before the full-board draw.
